# Introduction {#sec-introduction}

## Background

Manually copying analysis results into a manuscript can create inconsistencies between the code and the text. R provides a statistical computing environment [@r2026], and Quarto integrates executable analysis with document authoring [@quarto].

This unofficial starter follows the document sequence provided by the SNU Library. Department-specific requirements must be checked before submission.

## Objectives

The example demonstrates how to update a manuscript and its analysis together. @sec-methods describes the methods, and @sec-results presents the results.

A footnote can contain supplementary information.[^example]
